scope: 15 additional original two-part subsystem and mobility reports. Together with the existing nine reports this covers all 24 damage captions from these two paths. Isolated source proof does not establish live occurrence; playback requires a complete pixel-verified original assignment.
status: Automated wording checked; digit delivery checked where required; human listening review pending

No added words or vocal noises.
